title: reject: request
description: Answer a run's open cue by rejecting its changes: remove its worktree, change nothing in the working tree, and record the rejection in the cue's role. A request never names a path or a role.

run.description: The run, by id or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, recorded in lineage. Absent: none was given.

rehearse.description: Change nothing: make every check a reject makes, and report the worktree it would remove. Absent means false.
